::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 27 1868  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS.55388 (1): P. 490
:::

Dear Miss Yonge,
[I](people/person_939.qmd) was from home when your note about Index & [Miss Sewell](people/person_1606.qmd)’s suggestion of a chronological table came to hand.[^1]  But I have not been neglecting the suggestion. We are having a set of proofs made & shall put them into the hands of a competent person and submit the proofs to you.

With regard to announcing volume 3 [*Next few lines illegible*] the printers want something to do [*illegible*] and long and we have set them to work on the [Chaplet of Pearls](cmy_books/cmybook_69.qmd). You need not worry youself with this connection. Your story will end I suppose about October & we should publish about the same time.[^2]

I was sorry to miss you when you were in town.

Yours very faithfully
A. Macmillan

---

[^1]: These were for the *Historical Selections* compiled by CMY and Elizabeth Sewell.
[^2]: *The Chaplet of Pearls* was being serialized in *[MP](organizations/other_52.qmd)*.
